**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.** Here’s how: | Agency | How to File | Contact | |--------|-------------|---------| | **Atlanta Police Department (Non‑Emergency)** | Call 404‑656‑4000 or use the city’s 311 portal. | Phone: 404‑656‑4000
Online: https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | **Department of Public Works (Noise & Environmental)** | Call 404‑656‑4000 or submit a form online. | Phone: 404‑656‑4000
Online: https://www.atlantaga.gov/departments/public-works | ### Steps to File a Complaint 1. **Gather Details** * Date & time of the disturbance * Exact location (address or intersection) * Description of the noise (e.g., construction, loud music, barking dogs) * Any relevant evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings) 2. **Choose Your Preferred Method** * **Phone:** Call the non‑emergency line (404‑656‑4000) and follow the prompts for “noise” or “public works.” * **Online:** Visit the 311 portal or the Public Works page and fill out the “Noise Complaint” form. 3. **Submit the Complaint** * Provide all requested information. * If you’re filing online, you’ll receive a confirmation email with a reference number. 4. **Follow Up** * Keep the reference number handy. * If you don’t hear back within a few days, call the same number and ask for an update using your reference number. ### Quick Tips * **Time Limits:** For most noise complaints, it’s best to report within 24–48 hours of the incident. * **Repeat Offenders:** If the same source keeps violating the ordinance, you can request a “repeat offender” investigation. * **Legal Basis:** Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 5 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets permissible decibel limits and quiet hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). Feel free to let me know if you have a specific situation (e.g., construction, barking dogs, loud parties), and I can tailor the guidance further!
